packageRules.description: Merge an update once CI on it has passed: the Automerge workflow merges it when CI finishes, and Renovate during its own runs. rebaseWhen above rebases a branch that falls behind main (the runner's config rebases only conflicted ones), so an update opened while main was red is tested again once main is fixed.
The ANTLR tool generates the parser and the ANTLR runtime runs it, so both move to a new version together.
The PIT JUnit 5 plugin runs inside PIT, so both move to a new version together.
Maven build plugins only affect the build: update them in one pull request.
Update the CI workflow's actions in one pull request.
